leaves.name: chevalleyPerfect
leaves.doc: semiab-descend, printed form: Chevalley's structure theorem over a perfect field (Conrad, J. Ramanujan Math. Soc. 17 (2002) Thm 1.1; Milne, Algebraic Groups (2017) Thm 8.27; numbers UNVERIFIED): a smooth connected group scheme G of finite type over a perfect field k has a unique normal smooth connected affine subgroup H with G/H an abelian variety. Lean form: existence of a faithfully flat homomorphism pi : G -> B onto an abelian variety (PkgI3.AbVar) whose scheme-theoretic kernel G x_B Spec k is smooth, connected and affine, and uniqueness of that kernel on T-points; G/H read as the target of a faithfully flat homomorphism with kernel H (the definition of a quotient, Milne AG section 5.c). Replaces the glue semiAbelianDescendsPerfect (ZInQ.SemiAbDescend.semiAbelianDescendsPerfect_of_chevalley proves it for every perfect field).
